profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA. Its website, captured through the Power Automate product page, describes the platform as a tool for automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI-powered, digital, and robotic process automation. The site includes customer testimony that a data validation process previously requiring over 100 people can now be managed by just a few people using generative AI and Power Automate, and it cites placement in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Robotic Process Automation as of June 2025.

Microsoft's tracked AI products span several categories. In automation, Microsoft Power Automate AI offers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot and M365 integration and data loss prevention controls. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across Microsoft 365. Azure OpenAI Service delivers OpenAI models within Azure infrastructure with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls, while Azure Machine Learning provides an MLOps platform with AutoML and a model registry. On the developer tools side, AutoGen is a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Semantic Kernel is a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java, and Microsoft Agent Framework is described as the successor to both, offering a unified agent SDK with native MCP and A2A support, expected in 2026. Additional products include Microsoft Designer for image generation, Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps, SharePoint AI for enterprise content, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing.

Microsoft reported revenue of $331,839,000,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, and trades on public markets under the ticker MSFT with SEC CIK 0000789019. The held facts associate Microsoft with two active cases in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc., both involving its partner OpenAI.
